purpose: Audit whether a source-supported phone/model constant or body-frame lever-arm-like residual is identifiable from the sealed native Phase31 champion on the already-opened Phase29 development cohort. This is an offline development diagnostic; no correction is fitted or applied in this phase.

scope.truth_role: post-run development-only residual labeling; never solver, inference, or candidate-selection input

residual_definition.alignment: exact key intersection of sealed prediction and Phase29 truth; missing and extra keys are reported, never interpolated
residual_definition.frame: local ENU at the first chronological matched truth coordinate; prediction minus truth in ECEF, then ECEF-to-ENU rotation at that fixed origin
residual_definition.sign: positive east/north/up means predicted position is in that direction from truth
residual_definition.robust_scale: component-wise median absolute deviation (MAD), unscaled; MAD-to-sigma factor is not assumed
residual_definition.covariance: ordinary unbiased covariance over matched residual vectors and a reported component-wise 3-MAD inlier covariance; covariance is diagnostic only
residual_definition.outlier_rule: inlier iff every ENU component is within 3 times its component MAD; if a component MAD is zero, exact equality is required
residual_definition.prefix_tail: chronologically sorted matched rows; prefix is first 25 percent and tail is last 25 percent, each with at least one row
residual_definition.orientation: raw-only nearest preceding UncalAccel and UncalMag sample within 250 ms; report availability and residual summaries by acceleration gravity-axis/sign and tilt-compensated magnetometer heading octant when estimable; no truth-derived heading or attitude
residual_definition.identifiability_gate: A deployable constant requires cross-route agreement in ENU after accounting for route frame, stable prefix/tail residual, and raw-only orientation independence. One Pixel5 route is insufficient for a Pixel5-family calibration claim. No per-route or per-timestamp fit is allowed.

promotion_policy.next_action_on_no_go: select the next raw physical factor only after recording the residual evidence; preserve Phase31 champion unchanged
